contract: Persistent EQ Cluster V3 member append
evaluationOrder: Project all existing cluster lifecycle states through the candidate Swing confirmedAt using closed candles only
Sort newly confirmed Swings by confirmedAt, sourceOpenTime, canonicalSwingId
Reject unavailable, wrong-side, duplicate, or actively assigned Swing identities
Evaluate the candidate directly against each ACTIVE cluster's immutable formationAnchor
Apply the frozen Price Gate and frozen Formation Independence contract
Resolve zero, one, or multiple compatible active clusters
If appended, emit one immutable member append record and update only the current projection

appendEligibility.side: SWING_HIGH may join EQH only; SWING_LOW may join EQL only
appendEligibility.priceReference: Immutable formationAnchor Swing price, never current reference mean and never a prior appended member
appendEligibility.priceGate: distanceATR(anchor, candidate) <= 0.7 using ATR14 at candidate confirmedAt
appendEligibility.firstSwingLifecycleForAppend: The ACTIVE cluster state replaces re-use of the raw anchor Swing lifecycle gate. The original lifecycle gate remains unchanged for creation of a new two-member cluster.
appendEligibility.memberExclusivity: Candidate must not belong to another active EQ cluster on the same side

decision.zeroCompatibleActiveClusters: Run the unchanged two-member creation contract against eligible unassigned Swing primitives

appendRecord.anchorPairFeatures: Frozen price and formation feature snapshot

referenceUpdate.formula: mean(all member prices visible as-of evaluationTime)
